positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a comprehensive safety system using Angular and .NET Core to allow the Blackbaud Labs team to manage the machines and user authorizations within the Blackbaud Makerspace. This system consisted of a website allowing employees to take tests to gain authorizations for the various machines within the Makerspace, as well as an administrative website allowing the administrators of the Makerspace to create tests, view machine usage, and manage user authorizations. Also participated in numerous ideation sessions which were intended for finding avenues for innovation such as new markets, new technologies, or using existing functionality in a new way.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Installed and upgraded both software and hardware across Morehouse’s campus and provided on-site technical support to Morehouse employees.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Designed a cross-platform application to accompany the opening of an EDUSerc Convention Center. Created Software Requirement Specification Templates which detailed the design to contracted Software Engineers.

positions.title: Printing Assistant
positions.description: Recorded and managed the inventory of over 120 books currently in circulation by Black Classic Press, also served as the Content Manager by updating the consumer facing website with new content pertaining to the books. Oversaw the research and implementation of new bookkeeping software for Black Classic Press.
